lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions across Zimbabwe using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications and affected population estimates were compiled into monthly near-term projection datasets for 2022, with multiple scenarios documented.
